newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 12.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from the noon report of Lithuania's M1 Plus radio station on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Danish police detained a Lithuanian national in Copenhagen airport for allegedly smuggling four kilograms or four million dollars worth of cocaine from Athens
